_about: Capture settings. Attribute names are the cart/order attributes a storefront snippet would copy from cookies and the landing URL into the order (note_attributes). Change them to match your theme.

consent._note: With require_for_all_ad_platforms=false the send rule follows the identifier rules only, and hashed email is used only when consent is granted. Set it to true to send nothing to ad platforms without a captured 'granted' signal.

ga4._policy_values: send | send_if_client_id | never. 'direct' = checkout inside the AI surface, where Shopify says GA and custom pixels do not fire. 'store' = the buyer finished on the store's own checkout, where the browser tag also records the purchase.
